evidence: 1. Live trigger of CodePulse-AI analysis successfully cloned and completed. All 8 intelligence files were generated in analyzers/dynamic/10489fe8-1dec-4561-b97c-11314025f5ab/.

Code review of 'updateJobStatus' in 'analysis.processor.ts' confirms it updates 'status' to 'COMPLETED' but fails to pass 'error: null', permanently leaving the old error string from transient failures.

3. The previous 'files missing' report was an artifact of hitting the Intelligence endpoints milliseconds after triggering the BullMQ job, bypassing the necessary processing time (approx 15 seconds) required by PyDriller and Lizard.
